mapper.sql: r.*, e.equip_code, e.equip_name, r.part_cost + r.outsource_cost AS total_cost, CASE WHEN r.recover_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.fail_dt, r.recover_dt) END AS down_min, CASE WHEN r.start_dt IS NULL OR r.end_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.start_dt, r.end_dt) END AS work_min, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_attach a WHERE a.ref_type = 'REPAIR' AND a.ref_id = r.repair_id) AS attach_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_repair_part p WHERE p.repair_id = r.repair_id) AS part_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM equipment_repair_hist r JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_id = r.equip_id WHERE r.repair_id = #{repairId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(repair_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM equipment_repair_hist WHERE repair_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_repair_hist SET equip_id = #{equipId}, fail_dt = #{failDt}, fail_type = #{failType}, alarm_code = #{alarmCode}, symptom = #{symptom}, cause = #{cause}, action = #{action}, repairer_name = #{repairerName}, repair_kind = #{repairKind}, vendor_name = #{vendorName}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, recover_dt = #{recoverDt}, test_result = #{testResult}, status = #{status}, part_cost = #{partCost}, outsource_cost = #{outsourceCost}, upd_user_id = #{updUserId}, upd_user_name = #{updUserName} WHERE repair_id = #{repairId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM equipment_repair_part WHERE repair_id = #{repairId} ORDER BY sort_order, part_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_repair_part (repair_id, part_name, part_no, qty, sort_order) VALUES (#{repairId}, #{partName}, #{partNo}, #{qty}, #{sortOrder})
